notes.title: New Game, New Bundle
notes.content:
It's been a while, Sudokube players! I'm here to announce the release of my new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428980/The_Count_of_Monte_Carlo/]'The Count of Monte Carlo'[/url], as well as the creation of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16255/Blank_Bundle/]Blank Bundle[/url] containing all my solo games.

Sudokube owners will find a sizeable discount waiting for them so check it out

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428980/The_Count_of_Monte_Carlo/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16255/Blank_Bundle/
